Requirements: Flutter 3.47.9 (Dart 3.13.7), pinned in pubspec.yaml: flutter pub get refuses another release, and the worker bundle, the formatter output and the CanvasKit build depend on it. No native dependencies.

git clone https://github.com/videjunior/opencadirrigation.git
cd opencadirrigation
flutter pub get
flutter run -d chrome              # development in the browser
flutter test                       # about 3,000 tests: engine, model, formats, interface
flutter analyze                    # lints
tool/build_worker.sh               # recompiles web/design_worker.js after changing lib/core (the app falls
                                   # back to the interface thread when the file is missing)
tool/build_web.sh                  # release build: worker + flutter build web with the git commit and date
                                   # baked into the version (welcome, status bar, Help → About, console),
                                   # CanvasKit served by the site and the offline service worker filled in
                                   # (tool/gen_sw.dart); OCI_WEB_OUT=<folder> writes the build elsewhere
flutter build web --release        # a plain build (no commit/date, CanvasKit from Google's CDN, no offline
                                   # start: its sw.js removes itself; build/web, web/CNAME holds the domain)
dart run bin/oci.dart --help       # command line: import, new, set, pack add, design, analyze, check, validate,
                                   # export, bom and schema of .oci.json projects (docs/API.md)
dart tool/engine_package.dart build/engine   # the engine as a package without Flutter (needs only the Dart SDK)
dart run tool/gen_version.dart     # regenerates lib/app/version.dart after changing `version:` in pubspec.yaml
dart run tool/gen_site.dart        # site pages (English index, /pt/, /es/, /de/, … sitemap, 404, robots, llms.txt)
dart run tool/indexnow.dart        # after a deploy: ask IndexNow engines (Bing…) to crawl the pages again
dart run tool/gen_catalogs.dart    # validates and normalises catalogs/*.oci.cat and rebuilds index.json
dart run tool/gen_examples.dart    # regenerates examples/<lang>/*.oci.json from lib/app/examples.dart
dart run tool/gen_brand.dart       # icons and brand assets from web/brand
python3 tool/formats/make_fixtures.py   # rewrites test/fixtures/formats with ezdxf, pyshp, tifffile, Pillow, openpyxl and LibreDWG
python3 tool/formats/check_exports.py   # validates build/formats (written by flutter test) with independent readers
python3 tool/fonts/build_fonts.py       # rebuilds the Noto subsets of assets/fonts from the interface strings
python3 tool/fonts/gen_unicode_data.py  # regenerates lib/core/io/fonts/unicode_data.dart from the Unicode Character Database
python3 tool/fonts/make_shaping_fixtures.py  # rewrites test/fixtures/shaping with HarfBuzz (uharfbuzz)
UPDATE_AI_TOOLS_DOC=1 flutter test test/widget_ai_coverage_test.dart  # regenerates docs/AI_TOOLS.md from the coverage map
flutter test --platform chrome test/web          # the *_web.dart code in a real Chrome
flutter test --update-goldens test/goldens       # rewrites the golden images
dart run tool/release.dart status                # the release checklist (prepare, build, publish, live, verify-build)
dart run tool/i18n_review.dart export <code>     # a language as a spreadsheet for native speakers (and import)
git config core.hooksPath tool/hooks             # the pre-commit hook: formatting, forbidden names, stale worker
npm ci --prefix tool/e2e                         # once: the end-to-end smoke test and its playwright-core
npm exec --prefix tool/e2e -- playwright-core install webkit firefox   # once: the pinned WebKit and Firefox builds
node tool/e2e/smoke.mjs build/web --browser chromium,webkit,firefox     # the smoke test of a production build

The command line runs the engine of the app in the Dart VM, without Flutter or a browser: design sizes and analyses a project (and writes the designed project, the results and every report table), analyze keeps the sizes as drawn, check lists the problems and exits with 1 on an error, validate says what reading the file had to repair, export writes any drawing format, bom prints the bill of materials and schema the JSON Schema of the project file, in any of the 20 languages (--lang); import, new, set and pack add make and change projects, and the commands that read projects take several files or folders at once, with --out-dir (docs/API.md).

The committed outputs of most generators have guard tests (the site pages, the service worker template, the examples, the catalogues, the version and the AI tools table): when one drifts from its source, the matching test fails and says which command to run. Rebuild the design worker (tool/build_worker.sh) after changing lib/core or the string table, and the PDF font subsets (tool/fonts/build_fonts.py) after adding characters, where no guard reminds you. Desktop builds (flutter run -d macos|windows|linux) use the isolate for the calculation. The android/ and ios/ folders are the project templates Flutter generated; native mobile builds have not been built or tested, and phones and tablets use the web app (installable as a PWA).

How to extend

  • New entity: class in entities.dart (JSON, clone, transform, grips, distance, bounds), EntityType, default layer, painting in painter.dart, properties in properties_panel.dart, tool in tools.dart and alias in shortcuts.dart, export in plot.dart/cad_export.dart.
  • New report: table in report_tables.dart (the CSV/TXT/XLSX/PDF exporters and the panel pick it up automatically) and texts in i18n.dart.
  • New format: reader or writer in lib/core/io, entry in the controller's importFile or in DrawingFormat/ReportFormat, and a round-trip test.
  • New formula: in lib/core/hydraulics, with a test against a reference value.
  • New AI tool: a tool in lib/app/ai/agent_tools*.dart (sent with every request) or an operation in lib/app/ai/ops_*.dart (found with find_operations), over the controller, with its input schema and its effect (read, change, export or a request to another service), and its route in lib/app/ai/ai_coverage.dart. test/widget_ai_tools_test.dart checks names and schemas, test/widget_ai_coverage_test.dart fails when a command, tool, menu item or dialog has no route, and test/widget_ai_manual_test.dart when the manual misses an item key, a design parameter or a message code.
  • Interface colours: take them from Cad.* (lib/app/theme.dart), adding a token to both palettes when none fits; test/widget_theme_test.dart checks the contrast of the light text tokens (4.5:1 on every light surface).

Tests

flutter test runs about 3,000 tests in a few minutes (the number grows with every version). What each group guarantees:

File Coverage
core/hydraulics_test.dart Hazen-Williams against a textbook value; Darcy-Weisbach ≈ Hazen-Williams on smooth PVC; laminar factor; Swamee-Jain ≈ Colebrook; continuity and slope match at the transition; Christiansen F table and Scaloppi adjustment; equivalent diameter; emitter law and fit; application rate; overlap CU; CU/DU and the Keller-Karmeli EU (the worked example of the technical study); pump curve fit, operating point, CRF; K → flow form; PVC celerity; number formatting without scientific notation
core/network_test.dart Sparse solver; single pipe; loops; mass conservation; pressure-dependent emitters; pump; PRV; device curve; Darcy-Weisbach convergence; large branched network is fast; comparison with Christiansen; laterals on slopes; maximum length; feed positions; emitters above the available head stay closed (no backflow)
core/network_robustness_test.dart A pump near its shutoff head feeding a hundred emitters near zero pressure (against an independent bisection); a pump that one bad step used to lock closed; pressure-compensating emitters on a hill, dry above the grade line and starved below it; a pressure-reducing valve just above its setting stays open; a check valve fitted as a device stops reverse flow; 300 random tree networks (pumps, check valves, demands, every emitter exponent) converge to solutions that satisfy continuity and the head-loss laws; a line at rest behind an idle pump
core/valves_formulas_test.dart, core/pressure_class_test.dart, core/minor_fittings_test.dart, core/mains_frequency_test.dart Scobey and Manning laws in the solver; a pressure-sustaining valve holds its upstream setting and a flow-control valve its flow, hydrant flow limiters in a project; a variable-speed pump holds its outlet pressure flow after flow, with NPSH and efficiency curves; PVC and PE derating with temperature and the class as a sizing constraint (a 95 m supply never gets PN 80 PVC, warm water fails a pipe that passes at 20 °C); the losses of the drawn fittings; a 60 Hz pump on 50 Hz mains and the pump selection at the mains speed
core/invariance_test.dart Moving a project (also to UTM coordinates), drawing its pipes the other way round, saving and reopening it or changing the language leave the design as it was; inverse-distance terrain counts every spot height once

core/lp_test.dart Simplex: ≤/≥, equalities, infeasible, unbounded, a problem shaped like the sizing one
core/design_test.dart, core/sizing_features_test.dart, core/gaps_test.dart Block generator; connected graph; full analysis and sizing; LP no worse than greedy; telescoping; fittings; flushing; water hammer; overlap CU and emitters per plant; agronomy and controller programme; pump and motor selection; GeoTIFF DEM; pivot (spans, costs); looped mainline

Checks beyond the test suite

  • CI (GitHub Actions, .github/workflows/ci.yml, actions pinned by commit, Flutter read from pubspec.yaml): analysis without any issue, formatting, the design worker byte for byte, the generators without differences, the suite in four slices with coverage floors by folder (the timing tests, tagged perf, apart with a slack), the browser tests in Chrome, a production build checked by tool/release.dart verify-build with the end-to-end smoke test, and a formats job with pinned Python packages and LibreDWG; a matrix job runs the same smoke test in WebKit and Firefox on that build. Dependabot proposes updates of the packages and of the actions.
  • End-to-end smoke test (tool/e2e/smoke.mjs, pinned playwright-core): on a production build (sh tool/build_web.sh), the app opens an example and designs it in the Web Worker, prints the version of the build, installs its service worker and starts again offline, sends a message of the AI assistant with the user's key to a fake of the API (nothing leaves the machine), notices a design worker of another build and loads this build's, and shows no page error. --browser chromium,webkit,firefox uses the installed Chrome and the WebKit and Firefox builds the pinned version fixes; a check a browser cannot run is reported as skipped, never as passed.
  • Golden images (test/goldens, tag golden): the drawing board light and dark, dense hairlines on a 2× screen, a dialog on a phone and the SVG of a sheet, compared with a tolerance for the anti-aliasing of other platforms.
  • Hooks (git config core.hooksPath tool/hooks): the pre-commit hook refuses staged Dart files that are not formatted and any forbidden name in the lines a commit adds (the one list tool/hooks/banned-names.sha256, plus a local plain list in .git/info/banned-words) and warns about a design worker not rebuilt.
  • test/seams/ holds the tests that cross modules (agronomy and programme, paste between projects, the browser storage full), beside the tests of each module.

Known pitfalls when writing widget tests: the calculation is truly asynchronous and must run inside tester.runAsync; dialog titles may be upper-case; the canvas needs a defined window size; asset loading (catalogues) uses rootBundle and works in flutter test.
